constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.

speakers.description: An off-screen narrator speaking in Chinese.

description.text: A wide, motionless view of an empty railway station platform. The platform extends from the foreground toward the far end of the station, with a clear open space across the frame and no people visible anywhere. Above the platform, a rectangular station sign is mounted in clear view and is the only element carrying lettering. The scene stays still, and an off-screen narrator begins speaking in Chinese.

The shot cuts to a wide view of the same empty railway station platform. No people are present and no lettering appears. A train begins to pull away from the platform, its carriages sliding across the open view and clearing the frame as it departs. The platform is left behind in the same wide composition, and the off-screen narrator finishes the Chinese line as the train leaves.
